recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Revisit only as part of a broader PA editorial pass to make endpoint long definitions match short descriptions verbatim; that would be outside this issue's narrow reconciliation.
issue_request: FHIR-15520 was a Published/Persuasive PA change request for STU3 HealthcareService.endpoint. It recorded confusion about endpoint context when a HealthcareService has multiple locations and requested wording like "Technical endpoints providing access to electronic services operated for the healthcare service".
initial_application: Git commit bd89a75a69817d9d8a4b5590860ee5921f19e8c6 explicitly included GF#15520 and changed the old Location-oriented endpoint short text in the HealthcareService spreadsheet to the requested healthcare-service wording. Later source rework commits 33b409a4b6 and c69d71aa21 preserved that short text in the current XML StructureDefinition and search-parameter bundle while leaving the longer definition unchanged.
additional_context: HealthcareService is an active current-build resource in source/fhir.ini. The remaining longer definition is not word-for-word identical to the short text, but it remains service-scoped and does not imply the endpoint belongs only to one Location. PA's later FHIR-35805 guidance, already represented on the combined branch, separately clarifies when endpoint/contact/availability details should be split across HealthcareService and Location resources.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The authoritative current source already carries the requested short/search wording, and altering the longer definition or checked-in SVG tooltip would be optional editorial normalization rather than a required semantic fix for FHIR-15520.

related_jiras.note: Later PA guidance on single versus multiple HealthcareService locations includes endpoint details and supports the current service-vs-location interpretation, but it was already represented separately on the combined branch.
